label: define toggleActive for %s in %s
code: function toggleActive(selectedEl) { const group = selectedEl.parentElement; group.querySelectorAll('%s').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('%s')); selectedEl.classList.add('%s'); }

label: observe %s → add class %s
code: new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('%s'); }); }, { threshold: 0.1 }).observe(document.querySelector('%s'));
